name: JA_TH_AP_WHT_CERTIFICATES_ALL
description: JA_TH_AP_WHT_CERTIFICATES_ALL  contains all necessary information to issue withholding certificates. Its records are inserted by a server side program and retrieved during the certificate printing.

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier to the certificates.

columns.name: CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of  the certificate. The number is unique by Phor Ngor Dor type,establishment and period name.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the General Ledger set of books associated with the certificate record.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for the transaction.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the supplier associated to the payables transaction.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period name associated to the payable transaction.

columns.name: ESTABLISHMENT_ID
columns.description: Establishment identifier of the first party associated with a withholding certificate.

columns.name: PND_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Phor Ngor Dor type code associated to a withholding tax rate to identify withholding tax type.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_DATE
columns.description: Date on the current transaction used to determin the applicable withholding tax rates and rules.

columns.name: TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Stores the total withholding tax amount.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the withholding certificate.Possible values are VOID and GENERATED.

columns.name: CHECK_ID
columns.description: Check identifier associated with a withholding certificate.

columns.name: CHECK_NUMBER
columns.description: Check number printed on physical check.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ID
columns.description: User and bank facing number identifying the payment.

columns.name: REVENUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Revenue type associated with a transaction line

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Taxable base amount in functional currency.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the load job that created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
